lines.text: Many learners say: He speaks English very good.
Better: He speaks English very well.

native.hook: 动作后面用 well，不用 good！
native.tip: 中文的“好”既能说“好人”，也能说“说得好”，一个字两用。英语里 good 描述人和事物，well 说明动作做得好。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “He speaks English very good.”😅 中文“好”通用，英语动作要用 well：“He speaks English very well.”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“He speaks English very well.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Chinese uses one word for both, but English uses well to say how an action is done.
en.caption: Do you say “He speaks English very good.” 😅 English uses well to say how an action is done: “He speaks English very well.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
